name: "Freezer Friendly" Breakfast Burritos with Vegetarian Sausage, Hash Browns, Eggs, Salsa & Cheese (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Transfer hash brown patties to a baking sheet pan and arrange in a single layer. Place in the preheated oven and bake, turning halfway, until crisp and golden, 22-24 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, transfer vegan sausage patties to another baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. Add to the oven and bake until golden brown, 10-12 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 15 minutes.
While the sausage patties are baking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs, salsa, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup salsa
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are set, then remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, about 10 minutes.
When the burrito fillings have cooled, cut sausage patties in half.

Place tortillas on a flat surface. Place one hash brown, three sausage patty halves, about ¼-cup of eggs, and ¼-cup of cheese in the center of each tortilla. Fold in sides of the tortillas and roll tightly to close the burritos.

STORING: Wrap each burrito tightly in parchment paper, then transfer to a storage container or resealable bag and place in the freezer for up to 1 month. 

REHEATING: For best results, thaw burritos in the fridge overnight. Remove parchment from the burrito and heat in a microwave or toaster oven until burrito is warmed through. Enjoy!
